_note: Controlled query families for the mechanism analysis, written 2026-10-22 and committed before any scoring with them. Families express the same 5 PTB-XL superclass concepts in different forms: bare class names, fixed clinical descriptions (the frozen prompts_superclass.json set, referenced not copied), and report-style statements imitating German ECG report conventions. Report-style statements were written from general knowledge of report phrasing, not copied from or selected on PTB-XL reports. Every variant is reported; none is selected on results. Prototype-averaging variants (k random single-class training reports) are defined in src/mechanism.py.
